**ACCEPT**

No concrete setup blocker found. The accepted XML stream supports 1 GiB input, bounded token storage, and callback cancellation. The accepted document model provides source spans, stable handles, subtree removal, and query APIs; the owned API can be additive while preserving the borrowed API and its 16 MiB limit. The registered crate dependencies match the planned XML and macOS atomic-file seams.

The frozen contracts keep CSS, reference, and source-save work on accepted interfaces, give reference errors a local typed shape, and defer document editing until the owned interface is accepted. Arc-backed source ownership with span-based topology can avoid self-reference, source cloning, and reparsing; cancellation during table construction remains an explicit owned-document requirement.

The native plan is read-only, and its proposed API is not treated as accepted. The three std-only shells are registrations only, not production acceptance. No dependency adoption or code claim is implied.
